methods.fisher: scipy.stats.fisher_exact, alternative=two-sided, default exact method, rows A/B, columns success/failure; exact Fraction cross-check when combined n<=200
methods.newcombe: statsmodels confint_proportions_2indep(count1=B, count2=A, method=newcomb, compare=diff, alpha=0.05, correction=False)
methods.interaction: unpooled Wald risk-difference contrast G1-G2, independent four-binomial variance; scipy norm.sf two-sided; each success/failure>=5
methods.holm: statsmodels multipletests(method=holm, alpha=0.05); unsupported hypotheses retained as 1, not computed p

recommended_tolerances.tiny_p_policy: For 0<reference p<1e-10 require relative error <=1e-7 instead of absolute tolerance; do not accept zero. For reference underflow zero, accept binary64 zero but do not interpret as mathematical zero.

cases.numeric_note: SciPy binary64 underflow; mathematical p is positive, not exactly zero.
